excerpts.author: jvranek
excerpts.content: #630 helps clarify this. #625 overloaded the same builder preferences name in beacon api as builder spec but we switched it to disambiguate https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/630

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content:
I believe the best would be to make it the same object and all optional data, and the operator decides what to forward to the builder. 

The point is
1. The beacon node **needs** all information to select the bid
2. The builder **needs** some information to prepare the bid, this is a strict subset of the above. 
3. The operator **may** want to send more information to the builder

excerpts.author: potuz
